name: Argentina 2021-22 (Scaloni)
scopeNote: Argentina national team under Lionel Scaloni from the opening Copa America 2021 match (Argentina 1-1 Chile, 14 June 2021, Al Jazeera) to the 2022 World Cup final (3-3 France, won 4-2 on penalties, 18 December 2022, Irish Times). Counted: Copa America 2021 (final win v Brazil 10 July 2021, date from Coaches' Voice article of 13 July and the final being reported in these sources; day not read from a page), the CONMEBOL qualifiers played Sept 2021 to March 2022 (individual dates and the exact last qualifier not verified in this run) and the World Cup 2022 group, knockouts and final. The Finalissima (June 2022) and friendlies are context only; no page on the Finalissima was read. Style terms used by sources: fluid, 'constant approximation and numerical superiority' with a 'man-oriented' defensive system (Total Football Analysis), 4-4-2 retained in the base (Coaches' Voice, 2021), and system changes per opponent in 2022 (Scaloni: 'we are not one-dimensional'). The popular label 'Messi's team / Messi picks the XI' is not confirmed: sources show Messi's freedom and a Messi-centred structure, but Scaloni says the DT decides (2026, outside period). Final shape: Coaches' Voice (tier A) says 4-3-3 (De Paul inside, Mac Allister in front three; 4-4-2 only appears in the semi); a 3-5-2 appears in the quarter-final v Netherlands (TFA) and a back five late v Croatia; 3-5-2 for the final appears only in SEO pages (not used). Argentine press not mined for tactics (Ole and La Nacion pages did not surface).
openQuestions: Final shape: Coaches' Voice says 4-3-3 with Mac Allister in the front three and De Paul inside; SEO pages claim 3-5-2. Confirm with another tier A-B source (Zonal Marking, Cox) if needed.

Man-oriented vs zonal: TFA (preview) says 'extremely man-oriented defensive system'; TFA quarter-final says roles exchanged between man-marking and zonal; TFA final says players pass the man off when he enters their zone (zonal handoff). Coaches' Voice 2021: one-on-ones from lower block, zonal staggered corners. Mixed system, not pure man-marking.

Counter-evidence to Messi-centred player empowerment: TFA (June 2022) says 'Messi is no longer the system itself'; the Coaches' Voice final piece shows Messi tied into a collective front three; Scaloni's later (2026) denial that Messi picks the team is in the manager file, outside this period.

Pressing level in 2022: Coaches' Voice 2021 and TFA say aggressive high press; Yahoo/Coaches' Voice (final) describe deeper blocks when leading; Scaloni's mid-tournament changes mean no single pressing label.
Exact date of the Copa America final (10 July 2021) and the last CONMEBOL qualifier not read from a page; per-match counts of the counted work not verified.
Squad age and cohesion: the youngest-manager and youth debut facts are covered, but no tier A-B source on squad average age was read.
Finalissima 2022, Olé and La Nación interviews, Zonal Marking, Spielverlagerung and Michael Cox pages were not found/mined.
The Total Football Analysis Argentina v Paraguay qualifier piece is dated 2020-11 (before the period) and was excluded.
